description:
Zach Hyman's impact with the Edmonton Oilers continues to grow. Since his arrival in the 2021-22 season, he has consistently surpassed his previous goal totals each year. On March 24, 2024, he achieved a career milestone by notching his first 50-goal season. The memorable goal came during an Oilers power play, originating from an offensive zone faceoff. Positioned in his usual spot near the net, Hyman received a precise pass from Connor McDavid, tapping it into the net for the milestone goal. The genuine elation from his teammates as they celebrated with him reflects the high regard they hold for him as a valued member of the team.

description:
In the final game of the 2023-24 season for the Tampa Bay Lightning, Nikita Kucherov entered the game just one assist shy of reaching 100 for the season.  Late in the second period while on a power play, he reached that mark.  Positioned at his customary spot on the half-wall, Kucherov received a pass from the point and swiftly delivered a one-time feed to Brayden Point, stationed in the bumper position, who promptly converted the opportunity. This assist not only marked Kucherov's 100th of the season but also solidified his place as just the fifth player in hockey history to accomplish such a feat. In a display of camaraderie, Kucherov's teammates rushed to congratulate him on this remarkable achievement. With an illustrious career already adorned with two Stanley Cup championships, a Hart Trophy, and two Art Ross trophies, Kucherov continues to embellish his hockey legacy.

description:
Against the team he called home for the first nine years, John Tavares reaches a milestone in grand fashion, securing his 1,000th career point. In the waning moments of the third period, with the goalie pulled for the extra attacker, Tavares deflects William Nylander’s shot from the point. The puck ricochets out to Morgan Rielly, who swiftly hammers home the rebound to knot the game with just seven seconds left on the clock. Moments later, the entire Toronto team pours onto the ice from the bench to shower Tavares with congratulations for his remarkable achievement.

description:
Marc-Andre Fleury has had an illustrious career that includes three Stanley Cup championships, a Vezina Trophy and William M. Jennings Trophy in 20 NHL seasons. On Jan. 15, 2024, he etched his name in history once again by surpassing Patrick Roy for second place on the League’s all-time wins lists with his 552nd victory. True to his style, “The Flower” accomplished this feat in spectacular fashion, securing a flawless 5-0 shutout triumph over the New York Islanders. In the beginning sequence, Fleury stops a one-timer from Brock Nelson on an Islanders power play. Then in the middle of the third period, he stands tall once again by denying Jean-Gabriel Pageau's attempt. The crowd erupted into chants of "Fleury, Fleury," paying homage to the goaltender's extraordinary achievement.

description:
After Linus Ullmark also accomplished the feat last season with the Boston Bruins, Pittsburgh Penguins goaltender Tristan Jarry joins the elite ranks as the ninth NHL goaltender to score a goal by shooting the puck into the net (a feat previously achieved twice by Ron Hextall). This marked the 17th occurrence in League history where a goaltender has been credited with a goal in either the regular season or playoffs, encompassing scenarios where goalies were designated as scorers because they were the last player to touch the puck before an opponent scored on their own net. As the puck is dumped in and reaches Jarry's stick, he elevates it above the fray and into the center of the net. With the goal, Jarry also became the first goalie to do so in Penguins franchise history.

description:
Auston Matthews goal output was something to behold during the 2023-24 season. He became the 9th player in history to reach the milestone of 69 goals in a single season, marking the first time an American-born player achieved this feat. The last time 69 goals were scored in a season was back in 1995-96 by Mario Lemieux and it also matched the single season high of renowned goal scorer Mike Bossy. Matthews outpaced the second-highest goal scorer by an impressive margin of 12 goals, the largest difference since the 2007-08 season. His 69th goal was a testament to his skill, scored during a Toronto power play where he displayed his incredible shot release, rifling a wrist shot into the back of the net.
